Game Overview

In Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Woods of Nevia and conquer the wilderness with a single tap. Battle beasts, gather resources, and build your haven as threats intensify. Strategize, upgrade, and survive in this thrilling forest adventure, balancing hunger and health to ensure your survival against the odds.

Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Dive into Woods of Nevia and conquer the wilderness with a single tap.
